# scale_audit_2026_08_27

Real inputs to the 2026-08-27 live decide, captured from a read-only copy of the
production DB for the capital-scale proof matrix
(`tests/unit/live/test_sizing_scale.py`).

`scale_audit_2026_08_27.json` — equity $119,947.86, cash $7,161.89, 11 held
names, 13 decisions after rails, plus the last prices, position entry dates,
20-day dollar ADVs and the exact RiskRails in force that night.

`scale_audit_2026_08_27_golden.json` — the orders `translate()` produced for
those inputs **before** any of the sizing work, generated by running

    git show 00baa24:src/sma/live/orders.py

in a separate process. 00baa24 is the last commit that predates this work; do
not regenerate the golden from `HEAD` or `HEAD~1`, because the concurrent perf
commit e89f3bc accidentally contains the in-progress money-path files and would
make the comparison circular. Verify any replacement SHA has no `SizingPolicy`
reference in `src/sma/live/orders.py` first.
